🛠️ Patch v1.3 – Localization Update (Japanese Language Now Available!)
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970526/c831337238847612f935c6c860176e5ef0926c43.jpg"]

Hello everyone!

We're excited to announce that Patch v1.3 for Fumiko and the Village of Lust is now live!

🆕 What's New:
🌐 Japanese language support is now available!

You can now play the game in English or Japanese.

A language selection screen will appear when you start the game, allowing you to choose your preferred language.

Minor bug fixes and improvements.

We hope this update makes the game more accessible and enjoyable for players around the world. Thank you for playing and supporting us!

— HotBamboo Studio
